positions.title: Senior Lead, Program Management
bullets: Formalized PI planning across 12 teams by standardizing cross-team estimation and building shared capacity visibility; used Jira as the execution backbone and a purpose-built Google Sheets workbook as a flexible planning layer to prototype the process before migrating to permanent tooling.

Established cut-line communication protocols and trade-off frameworks that gave executives meaningful visibility into capacity and dependencies, enabling informed prioritization and reducing unstructured top-down pressure on teams.

Restructured the planning timeline by shifting preparation further left, enabling teams to enter each quarter with committed, well-defined work and improving delivery cadence predictability across the program.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
bullets: Directly managed two teams (Order Management and Item Master DevOps, ~6 engineers each) within a ~100-person engineering org; drove a replatforming effort from Ruby/Scala to Kotlin, reducing tech debt and improving platform scalability.
Reduced tech debt-driven support burden from 80% to 20% of team capacity, enabling sustained focus on feature development.

Inherited a team in chronic firefighting mode; stabilized operations within 3–6 months by providing air cover, enforcing severity-based SLAs, and transferring prioritization ownership back to the team.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
bullets: Led a Scrum team within a 100+ microservice ecosystem and reduced customer-impacting errors by 50% in 3 months by tightening ownership, on-call practices, and incident review discipline.

Expanded scope to lead 3 Scrum teams (~15–20 engineers) supporting Comcast's customer service messaging platform, reduced custom workflow implementation time from 3 months to 1 month, and mentored and hired talent across remote teams.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
bullets: Served as Scrum Master and program manager for the Comcast Messaging Platform (~10 DevOps engineers, 3–4 QA), responsible for all customer-facing SMS and email interactions across non-marketing channels.
Led the phased AWS migration of the messaging platform; completed bulk traffic cutover in 6 months and full migration in 10–12 months, beating the original 12–18 month target.
Integrated Comcast's AI assistant with the SMS platform, enabling customers to interact with automated troubleshooting workflows via interactive SMS dialog.

positions.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
bullets: Returned as the company was divested from eBay and established as an independent business, managing corporate IT acquisition and conversion projects within SAP through the separation.

Held overall project management responsibility for moving roughly 500 to 1,000 employees to ADP payroll, coordinating Payroll, HR, Legal, and outside providers across requirements, communications, and training.

positions.title: Project Manager, Microsoft National Business Unit
bullets: Managed SharePoint and Office 365 (now Microsoft 365) implementation projects for client organizations, delivered as a series of short, sequential engagements.

Delivered an internal SharePoint knowledge portal for JLL in Chicago, the largest engagement at roughly six months, from requirements gathering through implementation and training, with regular on-site work.
Supported testing and acceptance of the portal, including building the prototype of the Selenium test framework used on the site.
Assessed risk, estimated effort, drafted statements of work, tracked project budgets, and managed client expectations across geographically dispersed delivery teams.

positions.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
bullets: Joined as a Project Manager and was promoted; one of the senior project managers on the Toys R Us account, handling its small-project pipeline and several of its most business-critical, technically complex projects, along with work for Sports Authority and Dick's Sporting Goods.
Delivered the Toys R Us omnichannel layaway program, rebuilding the payments flow to meet its requirements, and a complete rebuild of the Babies R Us baby registry.
Managed the full delivery lifecycle across engineering, operations, and business teams on platforms serving millions of users with strict peak-season uptime requirements.

profile.headline: Senior Technical Program Manager | Software Engineering Manager | Cloud Migration, Agile Delivery, AI Enablement
summary: I'm a software engineering and delivery leader with 20+ years of experience building high-performing teams, driving Agile transformation, and delivering complex technical programs at scale. I operate at the intersection of engineering execution and business outcomes, whether that means stabilizing a struggling team, standing up a planning framework across a 100-person org, or leading a large-scale cloud migration while keeping everything else moving.

My background spans both Engineering Manager and Technical Program Manager roles, which means I bring technical credibility, delivery discipline, and the ability to align engineers, product, and leadership around what matters. I lead through clarity, not authority, and I'm most effective in environments where the work is genuinely hard and the bar is high.
siteOnlyAbout: After a stretch of progressively demanding roles, I took an intentional break: I built personal software projects in modern stacks, developed hands-on fluency with AI tools including ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Claude, made music a serious pursuit, and spent meaningful time with family.
